description: IMMEC reconstructs plastic flows, stocks and selected legacy-substance concentrations in German buildings and infrastructure with national coverage from 1950 to 2023. University of Kassel and Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology researchers model six application groups, including pipes, insulation and flooring, using dynamic material-flow analysis and Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation. The release contains Python model files, XLSX inputs and summaries, and serialized full simulation arrays. Zenodo’s concept address currently resolves to version 3, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15487093, distributed free under CC BY-NC 4.0 in a roughly three-gigabyte ZIP. Historical input uncertainty, assumed lifetimes and software-version requirements are limitations for reproduction. Model execution also replaces generated result folders and can require substantial memory. Modellers could examine future waste implications or recycling scenarios using the documented stock structure. model-odym is the required underlying material-system framework. The metadata retain an older suggested citation DOI, so the current release identity is recorded explicitly. No archive was downloaded or model executed.
